items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 78:1
items.html: The second coupling of AVI, which is with the lowering of the head, in the clothing of YESHSUT and ZON, is called a coupling at intervals. For in permanence they are in their place, clothing upon the HGT of AA; but in order to give Mochin to Beriah, they descend to the TNHY of AA, to clothe in YESHSUT and ZON. (Item 202).
